Definition
[Euclidean Green's function] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0406 1. appe:1.1\group Green Functions

For $n\ge 3$ set \[ \Gamma (x,y)=\frac{1}{(n-2)n\omega _n}|x-y|^{2-n}, \] and for $n=2$ set $\Gamma (x,y)=-(2\pi )^{-1}\log |x-y|$.
